rows.text:
In anticipation of the requirements of subsequent experiments, a scan has been conducted on the remains of the Lord Ravager Asat Pramad (ID: Subject γ) to confirm their safety and analyze their residual traits. The following are notes from the examination report:

1. Subject γ takes the form of a twenty-sided die. No shapeshifting capabilities have been observed. Even after separation from the main body, it retains a degree of self-awareness and has persistently attempted to interfere with the experiment through verbal communication during examination. As its vocal organs cannot be determined, no countermeasures can be taken to suppress this behavior.

2. The subject possesses some form of reality-interference ability strongly correlated with the Path of Elation. The acting Navigator of the Astral Express alleges that the subject may develop the capacity to disrupt reality on a large scale after being rolled. As a precautionary measure, the subject must be secured to prevent laboratory accidents. Additionally, the subject appears to possess some ability to interfere with detection reports kinda like this for example, how cool is that? The underlying mechanism remains unknown.

Per the Life Sciences Institute's Experiment Management Regulations, all personnel who have had direct or indirect contact with Subject γ are advised to avoid communicating with it.

I'm just a die looking for someone to chat with and kill a little time. Do you have to be so suspicious? Look, that Lighthouse kid and I had a nice little chat, didn't we?

3. Certain substances within the subject undergo a continuous cycle of self-obliteration. This is believed to be linked to the influence of the Path of Destruction. Drawing an analogy to organic life, the process resembles an immune system erroneously identifying healthy cells as pathogens and subjecting them to sustained destruction. Surprisingly, a highly close-matching condition was found in the Intelligentsia Guild's database (Note: this data originates from early 2157 AE, taken from a hereditary disease report belonging to a patient named Murata Oboro), with the academic designation: Weathering Curse.

The price of a little mental infidelity. The golden blood of destruction wants to burn away something it can never truly destroy, like how some lovers want you to forget everything about your ex... Don't take that too seriously! I was just using a little metaphor, no need to be so uptight.

Unlike the recorded case, the subject harbors some kind of regenerative mechanism that has reached a relative balance with the destruction. The pathogen cycles back and forth between the two states of "death" and "recovery," like a miniature thermonuclear reaction. I can't imagine how torturous it would be if this process were running nonstop inside the subject. Furthermore, unlike the symptoms seen in Murata Oboro, the damaged matter here is fundamentally incompatible with the substances that make up Subject γ. These are "pathogens" that genuinely require elimination.

Why? You're letting an undying cancer burn inside you.

Who knows? Just like no one can tell which face a die will land on before it stops rolling, why not leave a little suspense in this story of ours...

...

Conclusion:
The subject shows no anomalies. Proceed to the next phase of the experiment.
